source.author: Omer Penek
source.verification: Poppler text extraction plus rendered inspection of complete PDF pages 150 and 154, Tables 28 and 31
source.scope: author's pp-chain analysis tables; not the later CNO 2022 measurement
source.excludedTable: Table 42 has a Be7 exponent inconsistent with Table 28 and collaboration open data; do not use Table 42 for Be7

cno.uncertainty: published asymmetric total interval including systematics; do not add rate uncertainty again

conversionPolicy.comparison: compare stellar production luminosity divided by 4*pi*(1 AU)^2 directly to published inferred all-flavor flux; do not multiply the model flux by electron survival probability a second time
conversionPolicy.ppChain: Penek chapter 10.10.2 equation 10.22: R=Ne*Phi*epsilon; epsilon folds scattering response and species-dependent survival from chapter 11.2. Use the published inferred flux conditionally, not an independent refit.
conversionPolicy.cno: Published three-flavor MSW inference, oscillation parameters from Esteban et al. 2020, and relative N13/O15/F17 contributions from B16; not a composition-independent detector likelihood.
conversionPolicy.limitations: G1 is conditional on each source's conversion assumptions. Changed production profiles, CNO ratios or a later intervention require response recalculation or quantified conversion-systematic validation before observational promotion. No common oscillation-parameter likelihood is fabricated.

sourceCautions: Fluxes are conditional inferences, not direct all-flavor counts; conversion conventions and their limitations are recorded above.
These widths are not independent Gaussian likelihoods.
Primary paper DOI 10.1038/s41586-018-0624-y full text was not available through the attempted publisher endpoint; accessible author thesis and collaboration data were used explicitly instead.
Structural inversions remain required; no partial-vector admission.
